question: Estimate the average number of reviews left per Amazon India shopper per year.
idealClarificationQuestions: Active Amazon India shopper (placed at least 1 order)? Yes.
Reviews on products (text + ratings)? Both — but a star rating without text counts.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Top-down: orders per shopper × review-rate per order.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Average orders per active Amazon shopper per year: ~25 (Prime users) or ~10 (non-Prime).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Weighted: 30M Prime × 25 + 50M non-Prime × 10 = 750M + 500M = 1.25B orders / 80M shoppers = ~16 orders/shopper.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: ~1-1.5 reviews per Amazon shopper per year.
